title: Remove the finalizer turn purpose and phase from the host protocol
outcome: The host protocol no longer carries a finalizer turn that no task can ever reach: TurnPurpose::Finalizer and SessionPhase::FinalizerOpen are gone from the wire vocabulary, the control evaluator and the docs, synchronized with TermAl.
acceptance: Both live stores are checked read-only beforehand, and no stored session phase, grant or turn result uses either value
TermAl's host adapter carries no reference to either value, confirmed with its owner in the same synchronization as the other wire changes

TurnPurpose::Finalizer and SessionPhase::FinalizerOpen are removed from the domain types, the control evaluator and the host and CLI docs, and a host request naming either is refused as an unknown value

completion.summary: Removed unreachable finalizer purpose/phase from the typed protocol and evaluator; unknown values refuse. Pre-edit store absence checks and synchronized host-owner confirmation are recorded. Corrected independent acceptance passes all four criteria; no criteria changed.
